main_text.l: Dum praeter solitum flamma furit ferox,
Mi, quem lectus habet morbidus, arida-
Sit cessare nefas: Laudibus at tuis-
Sit laus ergo tibi: fit decus: & tuum-
Et spirare quibus das, bone, das potens:
Et dicant, tua fit quanta potentia;
Nec non quàm bonitas fit tua multiplex.
Dirigue re gelu sanctorum corpora, quorum-
Ille calor viuas mentes super astra locauit:
Hoc durata modo perstant in secula: Sancti-
Æterni gemina parte ab utraque manent.
Nonne vides mites nutriri farre columbas,
Vnguibus aft aquilas uncis rostróque minaces,

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotation in the right margin ("Notes pour les Capucins morts de faim ... Melun") is manuscript, not printed; omitted. Underlining in the text is manuscript. Some words in the verse are uncertain due to fading and show-through (e.g., "Dirigue re gelu", "Vnguibus aft aquilas", "stricta"); "Dirigue" likely reads "Diriguere".
